title: Capability Census & Activation Matrix
brief: Inventory all source surfaces + external stores. Run live registry loads vs filesystem. Build activation matrix (on disk/loadable/callable/surfaced/product-relevant). Include Physics Fusion system (3 engines, 5 plugins, 95 tests) as a Tier 2+ product capability.

units.title: Inventory all source surfaces: engines, plugins, routes, MCP tools, hooks, scripts, skills
Inventory external stores: memory files, benchmark data, course assets, config
Run live registry loads vs filesystem — identify gaps between registered and on-disk
Build activation matrix columns: on_disk / loadable / callable / surfaced / product_relevant
Classify Physics Fusion system (3 engines, 5 plugins, 95 tests) as Tier 2+ product capability
Produce activation-matrix.json with per-capability status using MXU-MS0A taxonomy

exit_conditions: Activation matrix covers every discoverable capability
Gap count between on-disk and surfaced is quantified
